about_the_game:
Dive into the thrilling world of Aleato with this free demo, offering a taste of the dynamic roguelike dice game! In Aleato, your goal is to surpass each level’s score threshold by using unique dice and experimenting with strategic combos and perks.

In the Aleato Demo, you will;

  • Explore the First Chapter: Which includes 4 carefully designed levels, each with escalating score challenges that test your strategic prowess.

  • Craft Unique Dice: Experiment with a selection of specialized dice, including the explosive Bomb Dice and the versatile Joker Dice among others.

  • Use Perks for Powerful Builds: Choose from 20 unique perks to enhance your combos, allowing you to create synergistic builds tailored to your playstyle.

  • Strategize and Adapt: Every roll offers new opportunities to combine dice and perks creatively, ensuring each run feels fresh and exciting as you aim to outsmart the score thresholds.

The Aleato Demo gives you a glimpse of the depth and replayability that define the full game. This demo provides a standalone experience designed to showcase the core mechanics and strategic fun. Perfect for players who love roguelikes, dice games, or creative strategy, the Aleato Demo is your chance to roll the dice and discover what makes every run exhilarating!

Note: This demo only includes a small subset of the full game’s dice and perk collection.
